# Contributing

Thanks for helping improve these blueprints.

## Reporting issues
Open an issue with: the scenario, what you expected, what happened, and (if relevant) the Make.com error text. Never paste real Pixel IDs, access tokens, or customer data.

## Pull requests
- Keep credentials as placeholders (`YOUR_PIXEL_ID`, `YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN`).
- Test the scenario end-to-end in Make.com before submitting.
- Update the relevant `field-mapping.md` if you change module mappings.

## Security
Found something sensitive (a committed token, a data-leak path)? Email the maintainer via [stackarchitect.xyz](https://stackarchitect.xyz/) rather than opening a public issue.
